---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement / 建议新功能或改进
title: '[Feature] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**Motivation / 需求背景**
Describe why this feature is needed and what problem it solves. / 描述为什么需要这个功能，解决什么问题。

**Proposed solution / 期望方案**
Describe the behavior you expect. / 描述你期望的功能行为。

**Alternatives considered / 备选方案**
If any, describe alternative solutions you've considered. / 如有，描述你考虑过的替代方案。

**Additional context / 附加信息**
Any other context that helps explain the request. / 任何有助于理解需求的补充信息。
